packageRules.description: privacypass and voprf are built on rand_core 0.6, tls_codec 0.4 and blind-rsa-signatures 0.15, with getrandom 0.2 and 0.3 behind them. Moving one of these alone breaks the engine's build (see the comments in engine/Cargo.toml), so they move together with privacypass.

build/rust/cssparser-0.34 answers adblock-rust's cssparser 0.34 requirement with the cssparser Gecko vendors in third_party/rust, so its requirement is that version and moves only when the ESR base does. Any other version has nothing to resolve to, and the Gecko compile fails.

ESR point releases are security fixes, so they skip the weekly window and the release-age wait. They run the full CI, because a Gecko change can break Windows or macOS alone. A new ESR line (a major) is the annual rebase, done by hand.
A new ESR line is the annual rebase (upstream.txt). Listed after the rule above so it wins.
wasm-bindgen-cli writes the glue for the engine's wasm-bindgen crate and must match its version exactly, so it joins the rust crates group and both move in one pull request.
A 0.x minor bump of wasm-bindgen-cli is breaking, as the shared preset treats the crate's. Listed after the rule above so it wins.

customManagers.description: The Firefox ESR commit in upstream.txt. The tag in the comment above UPSTREAM_REF is the version; UPSTREAM_REF is its commit.
The wasm-bindgen-cli the CI image installs.
